profile_text.body:
TalkingPoints is a nonprofit that describes its platform as the only PreK-12 family engagement platform purpose-built to make partnership easy, inclusive, and impactful. According to its site, the research-based platform is built on the practices of Universal Family Engagement, an approach it says weaves trust and partnership into the everyday rhythm of school life. The site states that when families and schools work together, student attendance, behavior, well-being, and academic outcomes improve, and that leaders with tools to shape a positive learning culture strengthen whole systems. Its site features accounts from districts and schools including ECISD, Westlawn Elementary School in Fairfax County Public Schools, Eden Prairie Schools in Minnesota, Esperanza Cyber Charter School, and Putnam City Schools in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

The company's tracked product is also named TalkingPoints, listed in the Education and Research AI category. It provides translation in 100+ languages, described as human plus machine, and is used by teachers, administrators, and families. It is family-facing and requires no student accounts. The paid school and district version syncs contacts from the student information system, and a Common Sense privacy rating is not yet published. It is free for teachers in the United States and Canada, with paid school and district plans; a third party reported the free tier as up to 200 students and 5 classes.
